top_signals.title: How Large Denomination Bills Help Money Launderers
Odd Lots: Why Money Launderers Love $100 Bills (Podcast)
top_signals.summary: Hardly anyone nowadays seems to carry much cash, never mind carrying around a bunch of $100 bills. So why does the amount of physical cash in circulation — especially big denominations like the $100 bill — keep increasing? There’s a pretty obvious answer. All those dollars are being laundered and used by criminal enterprises.
